answer: Admission to the agent economy is metered by verifiable sequential work. Each identity solves a delay function whose output seeds the next epoch's puzzle, certifying one processor truly spent wall-clock minutes. The chain is strictly sequential, so an attacker fielding N puppets runs N delay chains: every fake identity pays the full time cost again, no batch discount, while an honest agent pays once. This sets a basalt floor under influence - immovable, untunnelable - priced in ferrous, non-transferable time, keeping influence willow-slender per identity.
